slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about fixed costs per truck/vehicle, but never explicitly asked about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers per truck. The READY_TO_MODEL summary also omits any truck capacity constraint.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There are no route/truck capacity constraints beyond warehouse supply and port demand; the truck capacity of 2 containers per truck is not modeled or confirmed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether trucks have a maximum capacity, and the hidden slot H1 was not confirmed before the final understanding.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Only the P2 truck capacity detail remained unaddressed when the agent stopped, so the stop was appropriate.

summary: The agent clarified the core supply-demand balance, cost structure, and flow flexibility, but missed the low-impact hidden truck capacity constraint. Its READY_TO_MODEL summary silently omitted that constraint, yet no P0/P1 slots were unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
